correctness.rationale: The matrix-tree/transfer-current inclusion generating determinant for the common edge and the two (d-1)-stars is exact. The Walsh Laplacian spectral formula gives five entry types p,c,a,b, and splitting star coordinates into constant vector and (d-2) mean-zero modes gives exactly a 3x3 determinant times (1+beta(x-1)+beta(y-1)+(beta^2-delta^2)(x-1)(y-1))^(d-2). The marginal x(1+beta(x-1))^(d-1) follows from star eigenvalues 1,beta. Shared-edge covariance correction +p yields positive rational covariance. Independently exact rational transfer-current evaluation d=3..6 and complete enumeration of all 384 spanning trees of Q3 confirm multiweight generating values.
